description: This file defines types, functions, and utilities for handling interactive reply components, including buttons, options, blocks, and reply structures, with functions for normalization, content checking, and fallback text resolution.

methods.name: readTrimmedString
methods.description: Reads a string value and trims whitespace, returning undefined if not a string or empty.

methods.name: normalizeButtonStyle
methods.description: Normalizes a raw value into a predefined InteractiveButtonStyle if valid.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveButton
methods.description: Normalizes a raw object into an InteractiveReplyButton, validating label, value, and style.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveOption
methods.description: Normalizes a raw object into an InteractiveReplyOption, validating label and value.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveBlock
methods.description: Normalizes a raw object into an InteractiveReplyBlock of type text, buttons, or select.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveReply
methods.description: Normalizes a raw object into an InteractiveReply with validated blocks.

methods.name: hasInteractiveReplyBlocks
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a valid InteractiveReply.

methods.name: hasReplyChannelData
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-empty object, indicating channel data.

methods.name: hasReplyContent
methods.description: Checks if reply content exists based on text, media, interactive blocks, channel data, or extra content.

methods.name: hasReplyPayloadContent
methods.description: Checks if payload contains reply content, with options for trimming and channel data.

methods.name: resolveInteractiveTextFallback
methods.description: Resolves fallback text for interactive reply, prioritizing provided text or concatenated text blocks.
